name: PT Berdikari Pondasi Perkasa Tbk
summary: PT Berdikari Pondasi Perkasa Tbk, based in Indonesia, specializes in foundational engineering, land stabilization, and marine construction projects. The company's diverse services include a range of piling methods such as driven, bored, hydraulic static, and micro piles. They also handle the installation of diaphragm walls, ground anchors, and sheet piling, in addition to conducting loading tests. Furthermore, the firm provides ground improvement techniques like vibro flotation, stone columns, and vertical drains, alongside specialized marine lifting and heavy-duty erection operations. Complementing these activities, PT Berdikari Pondasi Perkasa Tbk offers heavy equipment rental, including cranes. Founded in 1984, its main office is situated in Jakarta Barat, Indonesia.
